reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model PA-10, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The date code on the label, 2369, is outside the recalled date code range of 2126 to 2319, so the unit is not covered by the recall.
Because the date code is outside the recalled range, the claim is denied under the claim policy, which denies on an out-of-range date code.
No other claims share a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim, so duplicates do not affect the outcome.
